Workflows.title: Search, Filter, and Download Free Photo
Workflows.goal: Find a specific type of image using filters and download it for free. Success: Image download is triggered.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com
2. Type 'mountains' into the main search bar and press Enter
3. Click the 'Orientation' filter dropdown and select 'Landscape'
4. Click on the first image result to open the expanded view
5. Click the 'Download free' button in the top right corner

Workflows.title: Unsplash+ Subscription Discovery
Workflows.goal: Navigate to the Unsplash+ landing page to view premium benefits. Success: Unsplash+ landing page is displayed.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com
2. Click the 'Unsplash+' link in the top navigation bar
3. Verify the 'Get Unsplash+' call-to-action and premium feature list are visible

Workflows.title: Help Center: Keyword Search and Article Discovery
Workflows.goal: Search for licensing information and read a relevant article. Success: Article content is displayed.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://help.unsplash.com/en/
2. Type 'commercial use' into the 'Search for articles...' input field
3. Press Enter to view results
4. Click the article 'Can I use Unsplash images for personal or commercial projects?'
5. Verify the full article text loads

Workflows.title: Developer Portal: API Documentation Exploration
Workflows.goal: Navigate technical documentation for image integration. Success: Hotlinking requirements are visible.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/developers
2. Click 'View the documentation'
3. Click 'Guidelines & Crediting' in the left sidebar
4. Click 'Hotlinking' to view the technical requirements and CDN usage rules

Workflows.title: Access Unsplash Datasets (Lite and Full)
Workflows.goal: Navigate to the data portal and access dataset download links. Success: Redirected to GitHub or Typeform.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/data
2. To access the Lite version: Click 'Download' under the Lite dataset section to redirect to GitHub
3. To access the Full version: Click 'Request access' under the Full dataset section to open the Typeform application

Workflows.title: Blog: Category Filtering and Content Loading
Workflows.goal: Filter blog posts by category and load more content. Success: New posts are appended to the list.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/blog/
2. Click the 'Product' category link in the navigation
3. Scroll to the bottom of the page and click the 'Load more posts' button
4. Click on the title of a newly loaded article to read it

Workflows.title: Developer Registration Flow
Workflows.goal: Initiate the process to register as a developer. Success: Reach the registration form.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/developers
2. Click the 'Register as a developer' button
3. Note: This flow may be blocked by bot detection (Access Denied) in automated environments
